title: Japanese Maple Syrup Cake
description: A moist and flavorful Japanese-inspired cake featuring maple syrup as the primary sweetener. This recipe requires only a few ingredients and is perfect for a weekend brunch.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease a 9-inch round cake pan and set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, butter, maple syrup, eggs, and baking powder.
Pour the batter into the prepared cake pan and smooth the top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove the cake from the oven and let it cool in the pan for 5 minutes.
Transfer the cake to a wire rack to cool completely.
Once the cake is completely cool, dust it with powdered sugar and serve.
